<!-- Source page: Foundation DB -->

[FoundationDB](https://apple.github.io/foundationdb/) is a free and open-source multi-model distributed NoSQL database developed by Apple Inc. with a shared-nothing architecture.

It is documented in the [NixOS manual](https://nixos.org/manual/nixos/stable/#module-services-foundationdb).
